# nzapret TG-only v3.2.0-tg1

Telegram-only fork of nzapret.

- Starts only the `nztg` local MTProto proxy.
- Does not start `nfqws2`.
- Does not create NFQUEUE interception rules.
- Removes legacy `nzapret_out` chains and stops stale `nfqws2` processes when starting/upgrading from the full build.
- Keeps Telegram proxy configuration, secret, Cloudflare fallback, DC redirects, `tg://` link generation, and Telegram launch support.
- `nzapret start`, `stop`, and `restart` now control `nztg` only.
- Installer keeps only the architecture-specific `nztg` runtime binary.
